body:
Thanks @hkarani — solid precedence chain and good regression coverage.

Reviewed tip `5963fc77bd1c16b6b113f4d6f3c6ad42136725b1`. New findings:

1. [RISK] `src/lib/stores/ndk.ts:417` (and `:448`) — zap monitoring silently loses `ZAP_RELAYS`. `/api/config` now always returns `publicRelays` (defaults to `DEFAULT_PUBLIC_RELAYS` for existing deployments), and `resolveZapRelays` only falls back to `ZAP_RELAYS` when the arg is `undefined` — which never happens now. `wss://relay.coinos.io`, `wss://nwc.primal.net`, `wss://relay.primal.net` drop out of the zap NDK on plebeian.market prod; zap receipts published only to those relays go undetected → invoice status stuck pending. Union `ZAP_RELAYS` in, or pass the override only when explicitly configured (the `resolveZapRelays` docstring still claims it always unions `ZAP_RELAYS`).

2. [RISK] `src/routes/_dashboard-layout/dashboard/app-settings/app-miscelleneous.tsx:138` — Handler ID is editable in the owner UI, but discovery reads only `process.env.INSTANCE_HANDLER_ID` at boot (`src/server/startup.ts:26`). Publish under a new handlerId → event leaves the `#d` query chain → on restart settings silently revert to the legacy event, or with no legacy event `needsSetup` flips true and users land in `/setup`. Derive the chain from the resolved config or warn that env must change in lockstep.

3. [NIT] `src/lib/instance-config.ts:101` — `optionalBoolean` compares the raw string, so `INSTANCE_ALLOW_REGISTER="true "` (trailing space / CRLF) throws in `setAppSettings` → `process.exit(1)` at boot. Trim before comparing.

Happy to pair on fixes.
